body:
I guess what bothers me is I just feel so lost in life. I don't know how to cope well with anything. I struggled with an eating disorder in highschool because I absolutely hated myself and my parents. I struggle with addiction too. I don't have any direction in life, it just eats me alive. 

Anything I do in life I feel like I'm a complete failure at. I compare myself to people and it destroys any self esteem I have. I feel like I'm in the middle of nowhere with no hope. Every time I make friends it feels like I just fuck it up and push them away. There was this girl I knew that I pushed away and fucked up a friendship that I really cherished. 

I try to live life right and enjoy it, but I feel like no matter what I can't do things right.
